result.topic_en: A coloured hexagonal-lattice diagram ('scheme for 43') of residue classes of Eisenstein integers modulo a prime of norm 43, with a table of primes p ≡ 1 mod 3 written in the form a − bρ (ρ a cube root of unity) and notes on when 1−ρ is a quadratic residue of p.

methods.what: Representation of primes p ≡ 1 mod 3 as norms of Eisenstein integers a − bρ (p = a² + ab + b²)
Normalisation of a prime factor by multiplying by a unit power (−ρ)^k so that it is ≡ 1 mod (2−2ρ) (primary prime)
Table of quadratic character of 1−ρ for small primes 7, 13, 19, 31
Criterion for 1−ρ to be a quadratic residue or non-residue of p in terms of p(1−ρ)(1−ρ) modulo 12
Hexagonal lattice diagram of residue classes modulo the prime of norm 43

items.english: 1−ρ is a quadratic residue of p if p(1−ρ)(1−ρ) ≡ ±(1.4.7 / 7.7.10) mod 12.
Non-residue if the same is ≡ ±(1.1.10 / 1.7.4) mod 12.
